_base_branch_comment: The branch this project's work is measured against -- what
"changed files" means, and which branch generated links point at.
_visibility_comment: public: this repository's tracked files are a publication (it is
published to the Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons), so the
generated loader block leaves out every PRIVATE-level source.
_sources_comment: Declared at the 2026-10-01 migration onto the Precedent loader, as Morgan
chose them. The individual set is never declared here: it resolves
through the user-level config the session hook writes.

declined_adapters.reason: That hook serves practice-set repositories; this is a consuming repo, and tools/bootstrap.sh (from templates/bootstrap.sh) clones the shared sets precedent.json declares (spec/MIGRATING_EXISTING_INSTALLS.md step 8). Declined at the 2026-10-01 migration.
